title: Ulyana and the Sigil
author: W. M. Lockridge
blurb: Xanthe Galloway, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
